source_runtime.execution: Original Source viewProfilePackage invokes real pinned pnpm against a task-owned loopback registry; no mocked package command.

verification_scope_reason: Compare exact real pnpm results for latest/tag/exact/raw-v-prefixed versions, ordinary and prerelease ranges, latest preference, scoped identities and npm aliases, deprecation-aware range fallback, absent/nested fields, complete versus incomplete publication times, version/time/tag inventories and empty/missing versions. Initial differences exposed real pnpm's single selected manifest, preference for a matching latest, raw exact selector lookup and dropped incomplete publication times; these were corrected and observations retained. Native also verifies profile/user/environment registry precedence, scoped registry routing, environment token interpolation, auth prefix boundaries and stripped redirect authentication, URL credential removal, forbidden redirects, byte/Content-Length/JSON/content-encoding failures and HTTP failure classes. Shared SemVer now has an optional registry prerelease mode while its original host-compatibility default is unchanged; original compatibility regressions pass in the same targeted run.
legal_adaptation: Dependency-free Python metadata reads only, bounded by bytes, socket/deadline checks and caller-owned process cancellation when composed. Registry auth is confined to configured prefixes and stripped on redirects. This covers the metadata fields used by current management, not the full npm configuration or pnpm command language. An absent single field uses the internal unspecified value; paired observers normalize the absence of stdout.
activation_boundary: The native query library is ready for the built-in backend. It is not yet wired as the default manager command and does not install npm JavaScript code. Acquisition, native ABI validation, live/stopped transaction ownership and production/browser promotion remain pending.

cleanup.retained: Compact commands, original mismatch and corrected paired observations, registry requests and test reports. Shared pinned Source/toolchains owned through C9.
